Define diversity, give an example, and explain its significance.

interactive_activities.title: Explore geography and identity
interactive_activities.instructions: Complete an age-appropriate task focused specifically on geography and identity. Record the evidence/work and explain what it shows.

interactive_activities.title: Apply the idea
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where diversity is useful. Explain your reasoning and compare it with a second example.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach evidence to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps, using an example or demonstration.
